verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as batch terminal configuration or mass refunds, are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk or batch capability. It only shows single-item API actions (individual refunds, ordering terminals via the Management API) and general Customer Area management. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
